# Sofle upstream fixture

Verbatim files from ZMK v0.3.0 commit `edf5c0814fd3ea202e43aad2d68fd32e882a518c`, `app/boards/shields/sofle/`, copied 2026-10-19. SPDX MIT notices retained. Source: https://github.com/zmkfirmware/zmk/tree/edf5c0814fd3ea202e43aad2d68fd32e882a518c/app/boards/shields/sofle

Independent evidence for EC11 active-high pull-up channels (left 21/20, right 20/21), 80 steps, 20 triggers, shared sensor order and half-local enabling. Generated smaller fixtures keep existing preset switches rather than copying Sofle's matrix/display. See ../../expected/encoders/DIFFERENCES.md.
